rt:param.name: FreeLogic
rt:param.comment: строка логического выражения для вычисления ЗНАЧЕНИЯ (до 990 символов)

rt:param.name: Quality_FreeLogic
rt:param.comment: строка выражения для вычисления КАЧЕСТВА (до 990 символов)

rt:param.name: Grad_Style
rt:param.comment: Индикатор имеет градиентную заливку - объёмный фон

rt:model.rt:sub: Sub Calculate() NoGrad = False If ErrCount Then FColor = Color_Inval NoGrad = True Exit Sub End If Dim i As Integer Dim success As Boolean 'Проверяем недостоверность If Quality_FreeLogic == "NULL" Then //если алгоритм на задан, то плохое качество хотя бы одной переменной будет означать плохое качество For i = 0 To (InLimit - 1) If InUsed(i) Then If (InPV(i).Quality == PLS_QUAL_BAD) Then FColor = Color_Inval NoGrad = True Exit Sub End If End If Next i Else Dim ResQual As UByte success = PRJSPEC.FreeCalcs(ResString_Quality, ResQual) If (success == false) || (ResQual == PLS_QUAL_BAD) Then FColor = Color_Inval NoGrad = True Exit Sub End If End If 'вычисляем результат и меняем цвет Dim Res As Boolean success = PRJSPEC.FreeCalcs(ResString, Res) If (success == false) Then ErrCount = True FColor = Color_Inval NoGrad = True ElseIf (Res == true) Then FColor = VIS.Color(Col_ON) Else FColor = VIS.Color(Col_OFF) End If End Sub

'Разбираем строку FreeLogic = FreeLogic + " " ResString = "" For i = 1 To Len(FreeLogic) If (Mid(FreeLogic, i, 1) == "$") Then i = i + 1 Buf = Mid(FreeLogic, i, 2) j = CInt(Buf) If (j < 1) || (j > InLimit) || (InUsed (j - 1) == false) Then ErrCount = True Exit Sub Else ResString = ResString + "RTAPLS.BinPV(\"" + InPV(j - 1).PVId + "\").Value" If (j > 9) Then i = i + 1 End If End If ElseIf (Mid(FreeLogic, i, 1) == "@") Then i = i + 1 Buf = Mid(FreeLogic, i, 2) j = CInt(Buf) If (j < 1) || (j > InLimit) || (InUsed (j - 1) == false) Then ErrCount = True Exit Sub Else ResString = ResString + "RTAPLS.BinPV(\"" + InPV(j - 1).PVId + "\")" If (j > 9) Then i = i + 1 End If End If Else ResString = ResString + Mid(FreeLogic, i, 1) End If Next i If Quality_FreeLogic != "NULL" Then Quality_FreeLogic = Quality_FreeLogic + " " ResString_Quality = "" For i = 1 To Len(Quality_FreeLogic) If (Mid(Quality_FreeLogic, i, 1) == "$") Then i = i + 1 Buf = Mid(Quality_FreeLogic, i, 2) j = CInt(Buf) If (j < 1) || (j > InLimit) || (InUsed (j - 1) == false) Then ErrCount = True Exit Sub Else ResString_Quality = ResString_Quality + "RTAPLS.BinPV(\"" + InPV(j - 1).PVId + "\").Quality" If (j > 9) Then i = i + 1 End If End If ElseIf (Mid(Quality_FreeLogic, i, 1) == "@") Then i = i + 1 Buf = Mid(Quality_FreeLogic, i, 2) j = CInt(Buf) If (j < 1) || (j > InLimit) || (InUsed (j - 1) == false) Then ErrCount = True Exit Sub Else ResString_Quality = ResString_Quality + "RTAPLS.BinPV(\"" + InPV(j - 1).PVId + "\")" If (j > 9) Then i = i + 1 End If End If Else ResString_Quality = ResString_Quality + Mid(Quality_FreeLogic, i, 1) End If Next i End If

SelArea.height = Th_Ht SelArea.width = Th_Wdth

rect.rt:event: If ErrCount Then ShowWarning ("Ошибка логики\nили привязки.", 0) Else Dim s As String Dim i As Integer s = PointID_1 For i = 1 To (InLimit - 1) If InUsed(i) Then s = s + "|" + InPV(i).PVId End If Next i Open_Win_Uni(False, "multyKKS" + InPV(0).PVId, "Составной объект", "wi_MultyPV", s) End If

If ErrCount Then ShowWarning ("Ошибка логики\nили привязки.", 0) Else Dim s As String Dim i As Int Dim j As Int TmpBuffer(0) = PointID_1 j = 1 For i = 1 To (InLimit - 1) If InUsed(i) Then TmpBuffer(j) = InPV(i).PVId j = j + 1 End If Next i LoadPopUpMenu(PointID_1 + "|NONi|") End If
